The OAuth strategy that the external account provider supports. Optional when `enterprise_connection_id` is provided.
Can be one of `oauth_[provider]` or `oauth_token_[provider]`.
The `oauth_[provider]` strategy can be used for regular OAuth flows with redirects and a `redirect_url` parameter is also required.
The `oauth_token_[provider]` strategy can be used for native flows, along with a `token` or `code` parameter.
The ID of an enterprise connection to link. When provided, strategy is not required.
The authorization or grant code that an OAuth provider returns during authentication. Can be used with `oauth_token_[provider]` strategies.
The ID token that an OpenID Connect provider returns during authentication. Can be used with `oauth_token_[provider]` strategies.
Used with `oauth_[provider]`. The given value will be forwarded to the OIDC `login_hint` parameter of the generated redirect URL.

Used with `oauth_[provider]` or `enterprise_sso`. The given value will be forwarded to the OIDC `prompt` parameter of the generated redirect URL. When using shared credentials this value might be adjusted for security reasons.
